title: Grade 6 French — Mon, Jun 01
description: La routine quotidienne — Day 1 of 5: Reflexive verbs of daily routine (vocabulary)
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'la routine quotidienne' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La routine quotidienne' = the daily routine. 'Quotidien' = daily.

questions.question: What does 'se lever' mean?
options: To get up / to wake up and rise
questions.explanation: 'Se lever' = to get up. It is a reflexive verb (se + verb). 'Je me lève à 7h.' = I get up at 7.

questions.question: What does 'se laver' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Se laver' = to wash oneself. 'Je me lave.' = I wash myself.

questions.question: What does 's'habiller' mean?
questions.explanation: 'S'habiller' = to get dressed. 'Je m'habille.' = I get dressed.

questions.question: What does 'se brosser les dents' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Se brosser les dents' = to brush one's teeth. 'Les dents' = the teeth.

questions.question: What does 'se coucher' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Se coucher' = to go to bed. 'Je me couche à 22h.' = I go to bed at 10pm.

questions.question: What is special about verbs like 'se lever' and 'se laver'?
options: They are reflexive — they use a pronoun (me, te, se...)
questions.explanation: These are reflexive (pronominal) verbs: the action returns to the subject. They need a reflexive pronoun: me, te, se, nous, vous, se.

questions.question: What does 'se réveiller' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Se réveiller' = to wake up. (First you 'te réveilles', then you 'te lèves'.)

questions.question: What does 'se peigner' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Se peigner' = to comb one's hair. 'Je me peigne.' = I comb my hair.

questions.question: Which activity usually comes FIRST in the morning?
questions.explanation: 'Se réveiller' (to wake up) comes first in the morning.

questions.question: What does 'aller à l'école' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Aller à l'école' = to go to school.

questions.question: Which reflexive pronoun goes with 'je'?
questions.explanation: With 'je' the reflexive pronoun is 'me': je me lave, je me lève.

questions.question: What does 'se reposer' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Se reposer' = to rest. 'Le soir, je me repose.' = In the evening, I rest.

questions.question: Which activity usually comes LAST at night?
questions.explanation: 'Se coucher' (to go to bed) comes last at night.
